summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the rich repository, without committing and without running tests or repository code. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py registers the title formatter (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and adds the Control.title classmethod with a docstring. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, checking only is_terminal, with the Rich-cannot-restore docstring note. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one legacy dispatch branch calling term.set_title with the title. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Not verified: Black, mypy, and the test suite were not run, so all results are by reading only.
